text:
anya: Heads-up — saw a short but sharp p95 increase in MNL pop between 09:12–09:25 UTC. ~15–20% of requests had extra 80–160ms. Posting quick traces + logs.

infra-bot: alert: pop=mnl latency_p95_up 09:13 -> 09:24

anya: perf traces show kernel-selector flipflop + kvcache warmup. sample:
```
[kernel-selector] node=host-33 picked=matmul_opt v=0.7 -> fallback=generic v=0.34
[kernel-selector] selection_latency_ms=4.8
[kvcache] miss_rate=0.62 evict_rate=14/s warmup=true
[net] rtt_mean_ms=12 rtt_jitter_ms=9
```

ben: I profiled a noisy neighbor on the same host — procsteal spikes correlate with selection oscillation. top shows container B stealing cycles.

mike: Node-level CPU steal 18% during window. Also saw LDNS TTL change around 09:10 from 30s -> 5s, triggered re-resolve and short path flaps to a new peer.

leila: Is kernel selector oscillation because of latency metric reacting to jitter? We should add hysteresis or increase eval window.

anya: Agreed. Quick mitigations proposed:
- Pin kernel to generic when procsteal > 10% for 30s
- Increase kernel-selection eval window from 1s -> 3s
- Raise min batch timeout to reduce tiny-batch sensitivity during jitter
- Lower kvcache eviction aggressiveness for MNL pop for next 2h

ben: Also queued a quick routing rule to prefer upstream peer B (more stable) for 10m: /api/route override -> peer-B :thumbsup:

mike: Ran a micro-deploy with kernel pin and +3s window on two hosts; p95 back to normal within 2 mins.

anya: Follow-ups:
- Perf team to sanity-check kernel scoring weights (ben)
- Infra to investigate noisy tenant and consider soft-affinity (mike)
- Net to check LDNS push TTLs with provider (leila)

leila: Filing provider ticket and sharing logs: https://vendor.ticket/REDWOOD-1234

infra-bot: action taken: route-override applied -> peer-B ; kernel-pin experiment deployed to host-33/host-34

anya: Closing note — root cause appears to be combined: LDNS TTL change causing peer swap + transient noisy tenant leading kernel selector to oscillate and kvcache to under-warm. Mitigation worked; will monitor.

ben: I'll schedule a short runbook update for MNL pop.

mike: thanks all.
